metadata.title: Free growth diagnostic | Minaly
metadata.description: Answer about twenty questions to find your business bottleneck, measure its potential and choose the next move.
metadata.keywords: free growth diagnostic, business bottleneck, scaling coach

intro.title: Where does
intro.description: About twenty questions based on your real numbers. Find the step that holds you back, what you are not tracking, and what your next levers could unlock.

questions.audience: How large is the audience you can actually reach?
questions.leads: How many new qualified leads do you get each month?
questions.rdvPris: How many appointments are booked each month?
questions.rdvHonores: How many of those appointments actually happen?
questions.ventes: How many sales do you close each month?
questions.prix: What is your average customer value?
questions.retention: What share of your clients complete the program?
questions.heures: How many hours per week do you spend on this business?
questions.delegation: How much of delivery still depends on you personally?
questions.systemeAcq: What is your main acquisition system?
questions.convSysteme: What is that system's conversion rate?
questions.convEmail: What is your email conversion rate?
questions.contenu: How often do you publish content?
questions.plateforme: Which platforms do you publish on regularly?
questions.adsBudget: What is your monthly ad budget?
questions.adsRetour: Do you know how much your ads generate?
questions.adsCA: How much do they generate each month?
questions.suivi: Do you know your conversion rate at each step?
questions.leviers: What would you like to add but have not built yet?

help.audience: Email list, community and subscribers who are actually exposed to your content.
help.leads: People who share their contact details or send a serious inbound message.
help.rdvPris: Slots blocked in your calendar, whether they show up or not.
help.rdvHonores: Calls that actually happened. The rest are no-shows.
help.prix: The amount collected from one customer across the full journey, including payment plans.
help.retention: Drop-off costs more than the missing payment. It also weakens referrals.
help.heures: Everything included: content, sales, delivery and admin.
help.delegation: This determines whether the business can grow without your hours growing with it.
help.systemeAcq: The path most of your customers take before they buy today.
help.convSysteme: From exposed visitor to captured lead on your main channel.
help.emails: Email still tends to return the most for each euro invested.
help.convEmail: The share of recipients who take the action you want: book, buy or sign up.
help.contenu: Public content designed to attract a new audience.
help.plateforme: Select every platform where you publish regularly.
help.adsActif: Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok or another paid channel.
help.adsBudget: Media spend only, excluding agency fees.
help.adsRetour: Revenue directly attributed to these campaigns.
help.adsCA: Revenue attributed to campaigns during the last full month.
help.suivi: Without step-level tracking, optimization becomes guesswork.
help.leviers: Select what interests you. We will estimate the contribution of each lever to your numbers.

options.emailComplete: Yes, a sequence and a newsletter
options.trackingNone: No, I only look at revenue
options.trackingPartial: Some figures, not up to date

report.title: The constraint is here
report.bottleneckMessage: This is the step limiting the others. The report applies Minaly's benchmark references to the numbers you entered.
report.benchmarkSource: Funnel benchmarks used by Minaly's weekly brief

axisDescription.capture: Does your audience become a usable flow of contacts?
axisDescription.rdv: Do leads reach the step that creates a sales call?
axisDescription.presence: Does your calendar reflect the calls that actually happen?
axisDescription.closing: Do your calls produce enough customers?
axisDescription.valeur: Does each customer generate enough to fund the next step?
axisDescription.systeme: Can the business deliver without relying on all of your hours?

report.funnelTitle: Your funnel, today and after the fix
report.correctionNote: Scenario: {percent}% of the gap to the benchmark is closed. Other steps stay unchanged.
report.capNote: The scenario is capped at {cap} times current revenue. Delivery becomes the constraint beyond that point.
report.anglesIntro: What you do not track cannot be improved, and often costs more than what you do track.
report.noAngles: No blind spot detected from the answers you provided.
report.leversTitle: Levers you have not built yet
report.leversIntro: Estimated contribution from Minaly's funnel references after fixing the bottleneck. Contributions overlap partially.
report.noLevers: Select levers in the questionnaire to estimate their contribution.

profileDescriptions.1-1: You monetize well and the business no longer relies entirely on you. Your constraint is incoming volume, not your ability to handle it.
profileDescriptions.0-1: You know how to sell, but everything still runs through you. Each new customer costs hours you no longer have.
profileDescriptions.1-0: Your processes hold up, but your economics do not. A clean machine is built around an offer that does not earn enough per customer.
profileDescriptions.0-0: Neither your system nor your unit economics are viable. Working more will not unlock growth. Repair one step first.

nicheDescriptions.low: Your market does not yet support a high price, or your offer is not positioned for it. Volume alone will not compensate.
nicheDescriptions.fair: Your niche can support more than you charge today. Price is your least-used lever.
nicheDescriptions.high: Your niche accepts a high price and clients complete the journey. You can invest in acquisition without weakening margin.
nicheDescriptions.premium: Your niche is premium: high price accepted, strong closing and retention. Delivery capacity is the main constraint.

report.ctaDescription: Minaly connects your data, keeps the priority bottleneck visible and helps you run the next action.
report.disclaimer: Arithmetic scenario built from your numbers and Minaly's funnel references. It is not a forecast or a guarantee.

conversionSystem.title: Acquisition system conversion
conversionSystem.detail: You do not know what share of traffic becomes a lead. That makes it hard to tell whether content is actually creating customers.

emailPerformance.title: Email performance
emailPerformance.detail: You send emails without knowing what they return. Each sequence becomes another blind bet.

adReturn.title: Advertising return
adReturn.detail: You spend a budget without knowing its return. Missing measurement gets expensive quickly here.

adAttribution.title: Imprecise ad attribution
adAttribution.detail: A rough estimate is not enough to decide whether to increase or cut a budget.

stepRates.title: Step-by-step conversion rates
stepRates.detail: Without step-level measurement, optimization becomes guesswork, often on the step that was already working.

clientOrigin.title: Where customers actually come from
clientOrigin.detail: Without a measured entry point, you cannot deliberately repeat what worked.

notes.webinaire: Converts cold traffic and replaces some discovery calls.
notes.upsell: The fastest lever: it acts on customers you already acquired.
notes.vsl: Qualifies before the call and reduces irrelevant appointments.
notes.newsletter: Reactivates an audience you already captured without acquisition spend.
notes.seo: The best long-term return, and the slowest to start.
notes.retargeting: Recovers lost visitors. It assumes you have an active ad budget.
notes.parrainage: Almost no acquisition cost, but it depends on solid retention.
notes.podcast: Builds authority and shortens the sale. The effect takes time.
